description: A hostile interpretation of the immersive sim, where nothing is planned, and everything works. This game is a response to the current trend of Immersive Sim design, where every ability is perfectly suited to solve a specific problem in the game. In order to counter this "Lock and Key" philosophy, Mosa Lina is aggressively random.
name: Mosa Lina

objectives.versus_tertiary: Least deaths at end of run
